Binary saves have no natural-die shifts. A personally known-false depiction or operative True Seeing blocks conviction without rolling. Warning alone is not conclusive. This test is involuntary even for allies, with no willing auto-fail or repeated same-instance trial. For self, object, point or no-creature-target modes, select one other conscious perceived witness within120ft as the conviction anchor; the caster cannot supply belief in its own known fabrication. The witness perceives the depiction and tests once. This NEW anchor interpretation permits real utility without assigning a mind to an object; no witness means no effect after an otherwise legal committed cast. Hidden knowledge supplies no prepayment diagnostic.

Damage and ordinary healing already resolved are real and never reversed on disbelief. Future ongoing benefits require their original admitted recipient’s conviction; object/area utility requires its chosen anchor. No substituted psychic type, shadow percentage or blanket immunity is introduced. A child’s summoned body, item, resource restoration, information or travel requires that exact current complete source and a finite source-specific adapter; missing adapter facts hold that mode, not its family. NEW the wrapper cannot itself mint campaign knowledge, souls, materials or resource permissions absent from the child.

A foreign engine/pool/charge is never fabricated. NEW Reaction, Bonus Action, long-cast and nested casting/copy modes are not operationally admitted by this first version; retain them as named coverage holds, not a claim the native any-spell wording forbids them. A prepared native child uses its own first-family exemption; an unprepared imitated mode has no first-prepared exemption. The two cast events chronologically update cadence separately.

RIR5-Q05 — The outer120ft admits the creature/witness; the child retains its native range and geometry measured from the actual caster, without extra120ft. Both predicates must hold at child resolution. NEW outer and child concentration are one composite dependency occupying one normal concentration slot: replacing/breaking it ends both, with the child’s own earlier deadline/conditions also controlling. Outer maximum is60elapsed seconds from outer manifestation; child duration starts at its own manifestation and cannot exceed that maximum while ongoing. Native completed instantaneous consequences remain. No additional concentration slot or unpaid tether. A native child that needs simultaneous independent concentration beyond this one dependency remains held.

RIR5-Q06 — Live personally witnessed conclusive contradiction, actual applicable True Seeing, or successful Action INT(Investigation) against outer DC identifies the depiction for that observer. Use Core task degrees/natural shifts, collapsed success, and no repeat failed examination without new evidence/method. Only that recipient’s ongoing belief-dependent child ends; an anchor’s loss ends the anchored child with its actual cargo/support cleanup. Other observers retain their own histories. No damage/heal rollback, material refund or hidden identity/stat disclosure. Identification is permanent for this instance; later blindness, suppression of True Seeing or recrossing cannot manufacture renewed belief. A genuinely new paid outer cast is distinct but known repeated deception still supplies actual knowledge.

RIR5-Q07 — NEW lineage is outer→one native child→that child’s ordinary noncasting consequences. No recursively imitated wrapper, cast-grant, copied-feature release, or descendant imitation is admitted in this version; missing broader branches remain explicit holds. One active outer per caster; successful replacement ends the old one, while commitment displaces prior concentration even if countered. Generic Ready pays/holds only the outer at preparation; on legal Reaction release it resolves and then commits the child as the expressly new composite event, with its own costs/counter window. Child may not itself be held again. Outer suppression pauses current child operations, not clocks; source-native ending or retained-body exceptions govern. No replay, missed opportunity bank, reacquired dropped cargo or refunded stock. Damage dealers remain the actual caster and each child’s real source-specific roots; copying a name does not grant Null. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 remains limited to its seven accepted profiles.

Justification: Q01/Q04/Q07 expressly permit named NEW exclusions with useful positive examples. The finite Action-time paid composite preserves outer/child costs and provider constraints; Fireball and Mage Hand demonstrate real damage and useful physical work. No universal copy, foreign pool or free reaction is implied.

RIR5-Q18 — Select one personally perceived existing live illusion application and a depicted contiguous inanimate object part, including another caster’s image without ownership transfer or consent. A disguise does not duplicate the real body/item beneath it; only a separately depicted unoccupied object part can qualify. Images of creatures are NEW excluded from this first inanimate realization mode; the spell does not invent creature anatomy/profile/autonomy. RIR5-Q19 — NEW explicit temporary realization profile, not recovered material canon: one contiguous rigid nonsentient shape, fully inside the depicted part and a5ft cube; maximum25cubic ft of manifested volume; mass10lb, AC10, HP20, resistance/immunity/DR none, maximum supported static load500lb including all cargo and bodies. Actual support geometry/load is a whole-case prerequisite. It functions as a simple platform, barrier, step or open container; no moving mechanism, armor, weapon, consumable, valuable stock, creature or magic-item property. These NEW exclusions bound rather than erase useful support/barrier/carry applications. Unknown underlying material/structural facts stay held. An incoming source must independently permit object damage; naming the profile grants no hostile equipment attack.

RIR5-Q20 — Require empty physical volume at establishment, except contact with actual supporting surfaces/anchors with preverified load. RIR5-Q22 — The manifested10lb is finite functional nonstock matter: may be carried, used for cover/support/container work or lent, but NEW cannot become food, currency, valuable/component stock, ammunition, crafted permanent material or a consumed fuel/reagent. An attempted prohibited consumption/crafting preflight spends no ingredient, creates no product and cannot convert its20HP into a paid resource.

RIR5-Q23 — NEW directly damaging weapon/trap/creature use is outside this narrowly functional profile; no attack/damage stat is supplied for it. This does not erase independent actual Falling when its support ends. Existing illusion psychic/condition payloads keep their original source and cannot be counted as this object’s damage or hit. An actual incoming object-capable attack can damage its AC10/HP20 once under its own source. No copied Shadow Blade damage, Spectral Army attacks, free procs, damaging thrown-object profile or retroactive salvage.

RIR5-Q24 — NEW suppression retains the manifestation’s identity, HP, last location, ownership, prior custody record and original deadline; physical held status and current hand/custody are released but removes collision/support/manipulation. Real cargo/body loses support at that location and uses the actual fixed Fall Marker; suppression grants no instantaneous impact. On resumption, return physical properties only if the retained full volume is empty except legitimate support contacts and still structurally supported. Otherwise remain dormant until legal or expiry; no crushing, relocation, healed HP, reacquired cargo or undone fall. At expiry or dispel permanently end manifestation and settle real held/worn/cargo objects at actual locations. NEW only one realization per original illusion part and one active realization per caster; successful replacement ends old support before establishing new, after checking legal new placement. Recasts never reset the same object for free.

Justification: The explicitly NEW functional nonstock physical profile supplies useful real support and carrying without inventing permanent material, weapon, creature or component authority. Its independent native60second deadline preserves real custody and Falling.
